text_block_list.text:
I showed Seiun Sky the letters and gifts 
I'd received from fans yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so even I've finally started getting 
things like this, huh～

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"So, what's my present, I wonder~? Open it 
up and show me."

Opening the package, I found a small desk 
clock with an alarm function inside.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Is this really a gift from a fan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I love you, Seiun Sky-san, for always 
making races fun with your 
unpredictability!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I saw her taking a nap the other day. She 
didn't wake up at all, even when someone 
called out to her."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"If you'd like, please use this alarm 
clock. I'm sure it'll wake you right up!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...That's why.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fans really are watching me from all sorts 
of places, huh~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I really need to figure out how to slack 
off more efficiently..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding~ That's a classic Sei-chan 
joke for ya.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to display this watch 
with care~

The next morning, Seiun Sky arrived at 
school with plenty of time to spare, which 
was unusual for her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Good morning, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That alarm clock is way too powerful~. 
Even I can't stay asleep with that going 
off.
choice_data_list: You're already putting it to use, I see.
You're already putting it to use, I see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... it's a family motto. "Let 
the tools do the work."
choice_data_list: Is that really a family rule?
There's a family rule like that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Of course. It's just like how tools 
develop character the more you use them."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's why I let you do the work♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, waking up early is surprisingly 
nice once in a while~"

With his sleep schedule sorted out, Seiun 
Sky was showing a rare burst of 
motivation.
